class.name: OcgPrs3dDimensionaspect
class.brief_description: defines the attributes when drawing a Length Presentation.
class.description: ! defines the attributes when drawing a Length Presentation.

method.name: Prs3d_DimensionAspect
method.description: Constructs an empty framework to define the display of dimensions.

method.name: LineAspect
method.description: Returns the settings for the display of lines used in presentation of dimensions.

method.name: SetLineAspect
method.description: Sets the display attributes of lines used in presentation of dimensions.

method.name: TextAspect
method.description: Returns the settings for the display of text used in presentation of dimensions.

method.name: SetTextAspect
method.description: Sets the display attributes of text used in presentation of dimensions.

method.name: IsText3d
method.description: Check if text for dimension label is 3d.

method.name: MakeText3d
method.description: Sets type of text.

method.name: IsTextShaded
method.description: Check if 3d text for dimension label is shaded.

method.name: MakeTextShaded
method.description: Turns on/off text shading for 3d text.

method.name: IsArrows3d
method.description: Gets type of arrows.

method.name: MakeArrows3d
method.description: Sets type of arrows.

method.name: IsUnitsDisplayed
method.description: Shows if Units are to be displayed along with dimension value.

method.name: MakeUnitsDisplayed
method.description: Specifies whether the units string should be displayed along with value label or not.

method.name: SetArrowOrientation
method.description: Sets orientation of arrows (external or internal). By default orientation is chosen automatically according to situation and text label size.

method.name: ArrowOrientation
method.description: Gets orientation of arrows (external or internal).

method.name: SetTextVerticalPosition
method.description: Sets vertical text alignment for text label.

method.name: TextVerticalPosition
method.description: Gets vertical text alignment for text label.

method.name: SetTextHorizontalPosition
method.description: Sets horizontal text alignment for text label.

method.name: TextHorizontalPosition
method.description: Gets horizontal text alignment for text label.

method.name: ArrowAspect
method.description: Returns the settings for displaying arrows.

method.name: SetArrowAspect
method.description: Sets the display attributes of arrows used in presentation of dimensions.

method.name: SetCommonColor
method.description: Sets the same color for all parts of dimension: lines, arrows and text.

method.name: SetExtensionSize
method.description: Sets extension size.

method.name: ExtensionSize
method.description: Returns extension size.

method.name: SetArrowTailSize
method.description: Set size for arrow tail (extension without text).

method.name: ArrowTailSize
method.description: Returns arrow tail size.

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
